youtube_short.title: Your Retirement Calculator Is Lying to You
title_alternatives: The 4 Things Your Retirement Calculator Forgot
Why You're $847K Shorter Than You Think
youtube_short.description: That retirement calculator gave you a green checkmark — but it skipped 4 massive expenses. Healthcare costs alone average $315,000 out-of-pocket per couple. Then there's the IRS's 22% cut on every 401k dollar, sequence of returns risk, and real healthcare inflation cutting your purchasing power in half every 11 years. The gap adds up to $847,000 most people never see coming. Follow for more financial truths they don't teach. #retirementplanning #personalfinance #money #401k #investing
